About our company

WeRep is a UK business facilitation company that specialises in helping mostly none UK businesses and individuals to seamleesly navigate and thrive in the UK market place by effectively representing them across multidisciplinary sectors without them having to be physically present in the UK.

We cover Investment Facilitation, Operation Management, Brand Start-up, Shipping & Logistics, Seminar/Event Representation, Goods/Product Inspection, Customs Cargo Clearance & Delivery, Warehousing & Storage, Meeting/Conference Attendance, Personal Shopping, as well as Airport Pickups & Accommodation Facilitation.

Our team is made up of dependable and result-driven professionals who are committed to delivering value-adding solutions that meet your specific needs. No brief is too small or too complex, from as basic as picking up your team from the airport and procuring accommodation and doing personal shopping for clients and shipping right to their door step in their country of destination to starting up a brand or company from scratch for you here in the UK.


With our versatility and local know-how, we will effectively represent you in the UK, streamlining your business processes and reducing bureaucratic bottlenecks. so you can hit the ground running.
Let us be your UK partner and grow together - contact us today to learn more about how we can support your business.

Let's help you win in the UK now!

Our Mission

At WeRep, our mission is to enable businesses and individuals to leverage our multidisciplinary versatility and local knowledge to optimise their operations in the UK without having to physically visit the UK. Thereby saving on travelling expenses, reducing their carbon footprint and more importantly hitting the ground running in the UK.

Our Core Values

Sustainability

Representing companies and individuals in the UK means they don't have to fly or travel to the UK, thereby reducing carbon footprints. We strive to mitigate environmental impacts across all operations. Before you make your next UK trip, think if we can save you the Time, Money, Air-miles and Carbon footprint whilst leveraging our versatility and local knowledge to achieve even more efficiency.
